To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) an active and socially integratd lifestyle in late life may protect against dementia and AD; (2) there are three major pathways that may mediate this association; (3) these three pathways are: the cognitive reserve, the vascular, and the stress pathway; (4) further research is necessary to define better the mechanisms of these three pathways and to develop preventive and therapeutic strategies.
an active and integrated lifestyle in late age is associated with a lower risk of dementia and AD.

a healthy lifestyle in late life is associated with a reduced risk of dementia and AD.
